table.name: Country
table.purpose: Lookup table of countries (11 rows), each identified by an opaque numeric id. Referenced by Match (home/away team country context) and League (each league belongs to one country). Part of the European soccer database schema (League, Match, Player, Team, etc.).

col_001.name: country_id
col_001.description: Primary key: opaque numeric identifier for each country. Not a real-world ISO code; values are arbitrary internal ids (e.g. 1729 = England, 7809 = Germany, 17642 = Portugal). Referenced by Match.col_002 and Match.col_003 and by League.col_002.

col_002.name: name
col_002.description: Country name (e.g. England, Germany, Portugal, Spain). Unique across the 11 rows.

table.name: League
table.purpose: Lookup table of football (soccer) leagues/countries; one row per league, linked to a country and referenced by matches. Likely the European Soccer Database 'League' table (11 leagues).

col_001.name: league_id
col_001.description: Primary key of the league; unique integer identifier (e.g. 1729 = England Premier League). Referenced by Match columns col_002 and col_003 (league of the match).

col_002.name: country_id
col_002.description: Foreign key to Country.col_001; one-to-one here since each league belongs to one country (1729=England, 7809=Germany, 17642=Portugal, 21518=Spain, 24558=Switzerland).

col_003.name: league_name
col_003.description: Human-readable league name, e.g. 'England Premier League', 'Germany 1. Bundesliga', 'Belgium Jupiler League'.

table.name: Match
table.purpose: One row per soccer (football) match: teams, league, season, date, final score, player lineups with pitch coordinates, detailed match event XML, and pre-match betting odds from multiple bookmakers. This is the central fact table of a European soccer database (Kaggle "European Soccer Database" layout).

col_001.name: match_id
col_001.description: Synthetic primary key of the match row (1..25979, unique).

col_002.name: country_id
col_002.description: Foreign key to Country (and identical to league_id; 11 values mapping to England, Germany, Portugal, Spain, Switzerland, etc.).

col_003.name: league_id
col_003.description: Foreign key to League; 11 leagues such as England Premier League, Spain LIGA BBVA. Same value set as country_id because each country has one league in this dataset.

col_004.name: season
col_004.description: Season label in 'YYYY/YYYY' format, 2008/2009 through 2015/2016 (8 seasons).

col_005.name: stage
col_005.description: Matchweek / round number within the season, 1–38 (38 rounds of a typical league season).

col_007.name: match_api_id
col_007.description: External (source API) unique match identifier, ~483129–2216672, unique per row.

col_008.name: home_team_api_id
col_008.description: Foreign key to Team (Team.col_002); API id of the home team (299 distinct teams).

col_009.name: away_team_api_id
col_009.description: Foreign key to Team (Team.col_002); API id of the away team (299 distinct teams).

col_010.name: home_team_goal
col_010.description: Final goals scored by the home team (0–10).

col_011.name: away_team_goal
col_011.description: Final goals scored by the away team (0–9).

col_012.name: home_player_X1
col_012.description: Home team player 1's X coordinate on the pitch (formation grid, values ~0–2, mostly 1). Part of an 11-column home X-coordinate block (col_012–col_022); ~7% null when lineup missing.

col_023.name: away_player_X1
col_023.description: Away team player 1's X coordinate (mostly 1); mirrors the home X block (col_012–col_022).

col_034.name: home_player_Y1
col_034.description: Home team player 1's Y coordinate on the pitch (values up to 11, mostly 1); first of an 11-column home Y block (col_034–col_044).

col_038.name: home_player_Y5
col_038.description: Home team player 5's Y coordinate (mostly 3 or 7).

col_042.name: home_player_Y9
col_042.description: Home team player 9's Y coordinate (mostly 7, 8 or 10).

col_044.name: home_player_Y11
col_044.description: Home team player 11's Y coordinate (mostly 10–11, goalkeeper position).

col_045.name: away_player_Y1
col_045.description: Away team player 1's Y coordinate (mostly 1); mirrors home Y block.

col_049.name: away_player_Y5
col_049.description: Away team player 5's Y coordinate (mostly 3 or 7).

col_053.name: away_player_Y9
col_053.description: Away team player 9's Y coordinate (mostly 7, 8 or 10).

col_055.name: away_player_Y11
col_055.description: Away team player 11's Y coordinate (mostly 10–11, goalkeeper position).

table.name: Player
table.purpose: One row per football (soccer) player: identity, birth date, height and weight. This is the Player table of a European soccer database (cf. Match, Team, Player_Attributes).

col_001.name: player_id
col_001.description: Surrogate primary key of the Player table; unique integer 1-11075, one per player. Referenced by player-id columns in Match (lineup slots) and Player_Attributes.

col_002.name: player_api_id
col_002.description: External API identifier of the player (unique, wide range 2625-750584). Referenced by the player_api_id columns in Match and Player_Attributes, so it is the join key used by the source API data.

col_003.name: player_name
col_003.description: Player's full name (or common nickname, e.g. 'Kiko'). Nearly unique; duplicates like 'Danilo' are different players sharing a name.

col_004.name: player_fifa_api_id
col_004.description: FIFA (video game / EA) API identifier of the player; unique, referenced by Player_Attributes.col_002.

col_005.name: birthday
col_005.description: Player's date of birth (range 1967-1999, consistent with professional players active in the 2008-2016 European leagues covered by this database).

col_006.name: height_cm
col_006.description: Player height in centimetres (157.48-208.28, mean ~181.9; values are inch-converted multiples such as 182.88 = 6'0").

col_007.name: weight_lbs
col_007.description: Player weight in pounds (117-243, mean ~168, typical for footballers). The detected joins to Match/Player_Attributes/Team_Attributes id columns are spurious numeric coincidences, not real references.

table.name: Player_Attributes
table.purpose: FIFA-style skill and rating attributes for soccer players, snapshotted at many dates over time (one row per player per rating date). Matches the well-known European Soccer Database schema.

col_001.name: id
col_001.description: Synthetic primary key for this attribute snapshot row (1..183978, unique).

col_002.name: player_fifa_api_id
col_002.description: FIFA API identifier of the player; references Player.col_004. ~11k distinct players, each with many rating snapshots.

col_003.name: player_api_id
col_003.description: Internal API identifier of the player; references Player.col_002. Same player set as col_002.

col_004.name: date
col_004.description: Date the attribute snapshot was recorded (2007-02-22 to 2016-07-07).

col_008.name: attacking_work_rate
col_008.description: Attacking work rate: low/medium/high (plus dirty values like 'None','norm','stoc','le' — known data-quality issue in this dataset).

col_009.name: defensive_work_rate
col_009.description: Defensive work rate: low/medium/high (plus many dirty values such as '_0','o','2','9','es' — known data-quality issue).

col_035.name: marking
col_035.description: Marking rating, 1-96; low for most players (only defenders high).

col_038.name: gk_diving
col_038.description: Goalkeeper diving rating, 1-94; low for outfield players.

table.name: Team
table.purpose: One row per football (soccer) club/team; reference table for teams appearing in matches, with identifiers used by different data sources and the team's display name and short code. This is the European Soccer Database 'Team' table (Kaggle).

col_001.name: team_api_id
col_001.description: Primary key; team identifier from the primary data source API (e.g. API football IDs). Referenced by Match columns for home/away team and player assignments.

col_002.name: team_fifa_api_id
col_002.description: Team identifier from the FIFA data source; unique per team, referenced by Match columns col_008/col_009 (likely team_fifa_api_id on the match record).

col_005.name: team_short_name
col_005.description: Three-letter team abbreviation (e.g. SIE, CES, HIB); not unique across teams.

table.name: Team_Attributes
table.purpose: FIFA-style team playing-style ratings and class labels for football (soccer) teams, snapshotted at six dates between 2010 and 2015 (one row per team per snapshot). Matches the well-known European Soccer Database schema: build-up play, chance creation and defence attributes, each with a numeric rating (0-80ish) and a categorical class.

col_001.name: id
col_001.description: Surrogate primary key of the team-attributes snapshot row (1-1458, unique).

col_002.name: team_fifa_api_id
col_002.description: FIFA API identifier of the team; 288 distinct teams, up to 6 snapshots each. Joins to the team table's FIFA id.

col_003.name: team_api_id
col_003.description: External API identifier of the team (e.g. the match/team API id, values up to 274581); 288 distinct teams.

col_004.name: date
col_004.description: Snapshot date of the attribute ratings; only 6 distinct dates (Feb/Sep each year, 2010-2015).

col_005.name: build_up_play_speed
col_005.description: Numeric rating (20-80) of how fast the team builds up play.

col_006.name: build_up_play_speed_class
col_006.description: Class label for build-up speed: Slow / Balanced / Fast.

col_007.name: build_up_play_dribbling
col_007.description: Numeric rating of build-up dribbling; ~66% null (only populated in later snapshots).

col_008.name: build_up_play_dribbling_class
col_008.description: Class label for build-up dribbling: Little / Normal / Lots.

col_010.name: build_up_play_passing_class
col_010.description: Class label for build-up passing: Short / Mixed / Long.

col_011.name: build_up_play_positioning_class
col_011.description: Build-up positioning style: Organised / Free Form.

col_012.name: chance_creation_passing
col_012.description: Numeric rating (21-80) of chance creation via passing.

col_013.name: chance_creation_passing_class
col_013.description: Class label for chance-creation passing: Safe / Normal / Risky.

col_014.name: chance_creation_crossing
col_014.description: Numeric rating (20-80) of chance creation via crossing.

col_015.name: chance_creation_crossing_class
col_015.description: Class label for chance-creation crossing: Little / Normal / Lots.

col_016.name: chance_creation_shooting
col_016.description: Numeric rating (22-80) of chance creation via shooting.

col_017.name: chance_creation_shooting_class
col_017.description: Class label for chance-creation shooting: Little / Normal / Lots.

col_020.name: defence_pressure_class
col_020.description: Class label for defensive pressure: Deep / Medium / High.

col_022.name: defence_aggression_class
col_022.description: Class label for defensive aggression: Contain / Press / Double.

col_023.name: defence_team_width
col_023.description: Numeric rating (29-73) of defensive team width.

col_024.name: defence_team_width_class
col_024.description: Class label for defensive width: Narrow / Normal / Wide.

col_025.name: defence_defender_line_class
col_025.description: Defensive line behaviour: Cover / Offside Trap.
